messages:
lee: EU ingest lag reported for 2026-03-21 22:00-23:00 UTC. ~25m late, impacts daily aggregates. Need a low-risk recompute path that doesn't blow shared quotas.
anya: thanks. can we do a scoped recompute targeting tenant shards eu-west-01 and eu-west-02 only? estimate first then dry-run.
mike: yes. also prefer routing via `reserved-eu` pool. we had noisy shared-pool usage last month. need SRE approval for pool exception.
lee: SRE pinged: @sre-oncall please confirm reserved pool use for a 2-shard recompute canary.
infra-bot: SRE approval requested: request_id=req-20260321-22-01. awaiting response.
anya: operator checklist I'm drafting: 1) run estimate 2) run dry-run 3) run canary on one shard 4) verify aggregates delta 5) scale to second shard 6) post dashboard tile + ops note.
mike: also add a safety cutoff: if estimate > 7000 token-units abort and require manager signoff.
jordan: small API debate: should we surface `route_pool` in the modal dropdown or infer from region? explicit is better for audit.
anya: agree, explicit dropdown with the inferred default helps but still lets ops choose. show estimated token cost next to pool selection.
lee: here's the operator script snippet I'll put in runbook:
```
# 1) estimate
curl -s -X POST https://internal-console/api/v2/recompute/estimate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP" \
  -H "X-Route-Pool: reserved-eu" \
  -d '{"shards":["eu-west-01","eu-west-02"],"window":{"from":"2026-03-21T22:00:00Z","to":"2026-03-21T23:00:00Z"}}'

# 2) dry-run
curl -s -X POST https://internal-console/api/v2/recompute/dry_run \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP" \
  -H "X-Route-Pool: reserved-eu" \
  -d '{"shards":["eu-west-01"],"options":{"invalidate_cache":true}}'

# 3) canary run
curl -s -X POST https://internal-console/api/v2/recompute/run \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP" \
  -H "X-Route-Pool: reserved-eu" \
  -d '{"shards":["eu-west-01"],"priority":"canary","max_parallel":1,"safety":{"abort_if_est_over":7000}}'
```

mike: couple of notes: (1) add `report_affected_prefixes=true` so cache invalidation can be idempotent; (2) metric to watch: `agg-hours-delta-per-tenant` and `recompute-token-usage`.
anya: agreeing on `report_affected_prefixes`. we'll persist estimate record under `recompute.estimates` for auditing.
jordan: for console UX: add an inline tooltip showing sample tokens and a tiny progress timeline (estimate -> dry-run -> canary -> ramp). tag CS and Prod channels automatically when job status moves to running.
infra-bot: estimate accepted: est_id=est-20260321-eu-22, estimated_units=4120. persisted.
lee: est < cutoff, proceeding with dry-run on eu-west-01.
infra-bot: dry-run complete: dr_id=dr-20260321-eu-22, simulated_writes=0, simulated_prefixes=[tenant:acme/*].
mike: good. canary go-ahead once infra-bot queues the job. please keep SRE looped.
infra-bot: job queued: job_id=rb-9933 (shard=eu-west-01, pool=reserved-eu, priority=canary).
anya: watching. if `agg-hours-delta-per-tenant` shows >1% deviation abort and run full prefix invalidation.
jordan: I'll open a short UX ticket to surface `report_affected_prefixes` and `route_pool` on the recompute modal (UX-1298).
infra-bot: job succeeded: rb-9933 completed in 1m10s, writes=1200, prefixes_reported=tenant:acme/*, agg-hours-delta=0.4% (within threshold).
lee: starting ramp for eu-west-02 with max_parallel=2. tagging @sre-oncall for visibility.
mike: after ramp, let's add a console guard that blocks `priority:bypass` unless `sre_override` header present and logged.
anya: will add guard and update runbook. also we'll add a temporary dashboard tile: "Telemetry recompute 2026-03-21 22:00 UTC (EU)" with link to estimate and run ids.
lee: thanks team. filing follow-up retro note about improving quota-metering for small targeted recomputes so we don't require pool exceptions as often.
infra-bot: ramp job queued: job_id=rb-9934 (shard=eu-west-02, max_parallel=2).
jordan: nice. closing thread after rb-9934 completes, please paste final metrics here.
infra-bot: rb-9934 completed: total_units=4350, total_writes=2330, final_agg_delta=0.3%. archived estimate and run notes.
lee: closing. great job everyone. :tada:
